summary: Covers long- and short-haul freight trucking services, including truckload and less-than-truckload operations. Disclosure topics are greenhouse gas emissions, air quality, workforce conditions, health and safety, and accident and safety management.

questions.text: What are your organisation's gross global Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) CO2-e · Report gross global Scope 1 emissions for the reporting period, in metric tonnes CO2-e, covering direct emissions from sources you own or control.

questions.text: How does your organisation plan to manage its Scope 1 emissions over the short and long term, including any reduction targets and how you have performed against them?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe your short- and long-term strategy or plan, the emissions reduction targets, and an analysis of performance against those targets.

questions.text: What are your (1) total fuel consumed, (2) percentage natural gas and (3) percentage renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total fuel in gigajoules (GJ), then the percentages for (2) natural gas and (3) renewable.

questions.text: What were your organisation's air emissions of the following pollutants: (1) NOx (excluding N2O), (2) SOx and (3) particulate matter (PM10)?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) · Report the quantity of each pollutant separately in metric tonnes, stating how each was calculated or estimated.

questions.text: What are your (1) total recordable incident rate (TRIR) and (2) fatality rate for (a) direct employees and (b) contract employees?
questions.hint: Unit: Rate · Report each rate separately for direct employees and for contract employees, stating the exposure-hours basis used.

questions.text: What are your (1) voluntary and (2) involuntary turnover rates for all employees?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report the voluntary and involuntary turnover rates separately, as percentages.

questions.text: How does your organisation manage short-term and long-term driver health risks?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe your approach to driver health risks, such as fatigue, sedentary work and chronic conditions, including programmes and monitoring.

questions.text: How many road accidents and incidents did your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total count for the reporting period.

questions.text: What were the (1) number and (2) aggregate volume of spills and releases to the environment?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Cubic metres (m³) · Report (1) the number of spills and releases and (2) their aggregate volume in cubic metres.
Unit: RTK · Report revenue tonne-kilometres for the reporting period.
Unit: Number · Report the load factor as a number and state how it is calculated.

questions.text: How many employees and how many truck drivers does your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report (1) the total number of employees and (2) the number of truck drivers.
